# ppds_forms_add_field

Add one existing column to an existing Main-form section by stable IDs. Saves and verifies an unpublished draft; never publishes. Use dryRun=true for a write-free preview. Avoid simultaneous editors when concurrencyMode is preflight-only.

## Input schema

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| entityLogicalName | `String` | yes |  |
| formId | `Guid` | yes |  |
| sectionId | `Guid` | yes |  |
| fieldLogicalName | `String` | yes |  |
| expectedDraftHash | `String` | yes | Fingerprint from a fresh unpublished forms get |
| solutionUniqueName | `String` | no |  |
| dryRun | `Boolean` | no |  |
| confirmEnvironment | `String` | no | Exact environment URL acknowledgement for the first protected mutation in this session |

## Output

Returns `Task<FormAuthoringResult>`.
